shots.name: KA-FOOM Kicking Target

goals.title: Rock-O-Meter Skill Shot
goals.summary: Soft-plunge so the ball rolls the Rock-O-Meter switch while the top light blinks — the direct on-ramp to 2x/3x playfield.
goals.reward: ~100k x lit level, plus meter advances (Lvl 3 = 3x value + 2 advances) toward 2x playfield

steps.action: Soft-plunge into the Rock-O-Meter lane
steps.detail: Meter the plunge so the ball crawls up the right crossover and rolls the switch while the top insert blinks. Auto-qualifies the meter at the lit level; higher level = more advances toward 2x playfield. Adds +5s ball save.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot (Combo Hi-Five)
goals.summary: Plunge to the left crossover before the timer expires to start a Hi-Five combo chain — up to a 6-way Super Skill Shot.
goals.reward: ~500k x chain length (up to 6 shots), +3s ball save each

steps.action: Plunge to the left crossover before the timer runs out
steps.detail: This skill shot is on a timer, not switch-cancelled — feed the left crossover to start the chain. Feeds the upper-right flipper.

steps.action: Continue the combo
steps.detail: Chain side ramp / side loop repeatably up to 6 shots for the 6-way Super Skill Shot.

steps.action: Keep chaining lit shots
steps.detail: Each made shot extends the chain and adds ball-save time.

goals.title: Every Band-Member Combo In One Game

Running the whole set in one game raises your combo base value, lights an extra ball, and — with every city saved too — qualifies Toy Time Multiball, on top of the cash-outs banked along the way. The FooBot parts themselves come from the game's big features, not from these combos.
goals.reward: All band combos credited, FooBot parts and shot multipliers, and heavy Combotron progress

goals.title: Attract-Mode Game Modes Menu
goals.summary: Foo Fighters keeps a menu of alternate ways to play behind the flipper buttons, reachable before a game even starts. Holding both flippers while the machine runs its light show brings up a list that goes well past the standard game, including a standalone run at the final wizard mode.
instructions: During attract mode, with no game in progress, hold both flipper buttons together
Keep holding until a menu appears on the display
Competition runs Standard rules but hands out the mystery awards in a fixed order instead of at random
The Final Battle Challenge plays that wizard mode on its own, with its own separate high scores
Competition Install adjusts difficulty settings, touching Overlord multiball, timers and ball save behaviour
DJ Mixer is a jukebox for the music and playlists in the machine rather than a way to play
goals.reward: Standard, Competition, The Final Battle Challenge with its own high scores, Competition Install, and a DJ Mixer jukebox

goals.title: The Two Secret Skill Shots
goals.summary: Past the skill shots the game shows you at the start of a ball, Foo Fighters holds back two more it never names on the playfield. One buys extra ball save time and the other lights Overdrive outright, and both come down to how hard you plunge.
instructions: At the start of a ball, ignore the skill shots the display is offering
Plunge the ball into the left inlane for 2,500,000 and additional ball save time
Or plunge the ball into the left outlane for 5,000,000 and Overdrive lit immediately
Hitting any major switch disables the ordinary skill shots, so commit to the plunge you want
goals.reward: 2,500,000 plus extra ball save time from the left inlane, or 5,000,000 plus Overdrive lit from the left outlane

achievements.title: Third Time At The Overlord
achievements.desc: Reach and start the third Overlord multiball, The Pretender.

achievements.title: Into The Red
achievements.desc: Advance Combotron jackpots to red and collect the Combotron super at the Overlord.

achievements.title: Whole Band Credited
achievements.desc: Complete every band-member combo in a single game and cash each one at the Overlord.

achievements.title: All Six Parts Bolted On
achievements.desc: Collect all six FooBot parts and start FooBot Multiball off the lit left ramp.

achievements.title: Extra Stop On The Tour
achievements.desc: Complete enough cities to unlock and play one of the two bonus van destinations (Austin).

achievements.title: Every Box Ticked
achievements.desc: Satisfy every requirement — all van destinations, all three Overlord multiballs, FooBot Multiball — and start the final wizard mode.

achievements.title: Mech Down
achievements.desc: Survive all four phases of the final wizard mode and land the finishing blow at the Overlord.

drills.title: Metered Plunge
drills.text: Ease the plunge so the ball crawls up the right crossover and rolls the Rock-O-Meter switch while the top insert is still blinking. Too hard and it sails past, too soft and it never gets there — the whole drill is plunger pressure.

drills.title: Overlord Backhand
drills.text: Take the Overlord from a right-flipper cradle as a backhand, never on the fly. It is the most drain-prone area on the playfield, and a direct backhand into the arena targets is also the higher-paying way to cash a combo.

drills.title: Three Orbits, Then Hold
drills.text: Shoot the right orbit three times to fill the meter, then hold the last one until a mode and a multiball are already running. Relight the battery at the paddle behind the drops so the next fill is ready — the multiplier is worth nothing spent on an empty playfield.

drills.title: Ray Gun Pair
drills.text: Pass the ball across to hit one return-lane Ray Gun target, then immediately take the opposite one to double the multiplier again. Then fire your biggest shot — the multiplier is armed for the next shot only, so decide what it is going on before you start.

drills.title: Side Loop Triple
drills.text: Loop the side loop three times off its own feed to the upper-right flipper, then cash at the Overlord. Nothing scores until you cash out, so the drill ends at the Overlord, not at the third loop.

drills.title: Ramp, Spinner, Ramp
drills.text: Left ramp, rip the center spinner, then the side ramp, and cash it at the Overlord. The spinner link in the middle is what makes several of these scripted combos flow, so get comfortable shooting straight up the center between two ramp shots.

actionButton.label: UFO Button
actionButton.how: The captive ball under the clear UFO dome charges the lockdown bar button. Bank up to three uses — yellow for one, green for two, red for three — and each press hands you the most valuable lit shot during a van mode or a multiball.

uses.when: Van mode running with shots lit
uses.what: Takes the most valuable lit shot for you, though a spotted shot skips your ray gun and playfield multipliers.
Can spot an Overlord shot toward lighting lock, or toward the multiball itself once a ball is locked.

uses.when: Final Overlord shot of a phase
uses.what: Will not spot it, and the targets flanking the Overlord are off limits too.
Fills you straight to three uses.
The captive ball stops charging new uses unless you hit it right off a left crossover combo.

howItPlays.objective: Foo Fighters sends the band on tour against an alien Overlord: save cities from the tour van, beat the Overlord across three multiballs, and build a giant FooBot from the six band members' parts. Score everything under the Rock-O-Meter playfield multiplier and reach FooBot Multiball and the four-phase Final Battle.
loop: Spell V-A-N on the white-arrow shots, take the Left Ramp to the Tour Van, and pick a city; follow its lit shots and always bank it at the Overlord.
Cash band-member combos at the Overlord -- backhand the arena targets for the 5x cash-out -- and light Combotron Multiball after six of them.
Fill the Rock-O-Meter with three Right Orbit shots for 2x playfield, refill it for 3x, and arm the Ray Gun return-lane targets to multiply your single biggest shot.
Earn all six FooBot parts from the game's big features to light the Left Ramp for FooBot Multiball, then complete every city plus all three Overlord multiballs for The Final Battle.

lights.name: V-A-N & City Modes
lights.lit: White arrows light the V-A-N shots, and making them lights the Left Ramp, which feeds the Tour Van to hold the ball and let you pick a destination -- one V-A-N is enough for your first city, rising toward three later on.
lights.then: Choose a city and follow its lit shots -- the final shot of every van mode is always the Overlord -- then bank it; completing cities unlocks the Austin and D.C. bonus stops, both required before The Final Battle will light.

lights.name: Overlord Lock & Cash-Out
lights.lit: The three arena targets fronting the Overlord light the lock, then the Overlord shot locks a ball and its captive ball starts the multiball once you have pounded it enough times.
lights.then: Backhand the arena from the right flipper -- it is the most drain-prone spot on the playfield, so never take it on the fly -- for a 5x combo cash-out instead of the Overlord's 3x; once you have banked six cash-outs the Side Ramp lights for Combotron Multiball, and each of the three Overlord multiballs demands a longer qualify than the one before.

lights.name: Rock-O-Meter Playfield X
lights.lit: Three Right Orbit shots fill the Rock-O-Meter battery; filling it starts 2x playfield for about forty seconds, and filling it again while that runs upgrades to 3x and resets the timer.
lights.then: Relight the battery at the Mod-ulator paddle behind the drops so the next fill is ready, and hold that last orbit shot until a mode and a multiball are already running -- the multiplier is wasted on an empty playfield.

lights.name: Ray Gun Shot Multiplier
lights.lit: Hitting a Ray Gun return-lane target arms a 2x on your next shot, immediately hitting the opposite Ray Gun bumps it to 4x, and it stays armed until you take a shot.
lights.then: Point the armed multiplier at your single biggest shot -- an Area 51 or extra-ball shot under 3x playfield can reach nine figures -- since it stacks multiplicatively with the playfield and FooBot multipliers; rolling the return lanes relights the targets between uses.

lights.name: UFO Button
lights.lit: The UFO captive ball under the clear dome charges the lockdown-bar button -- yellow for one use, green for two, red for three -- and the charge holds until you spend it.

control.effect: each stored press collects whatever lit shot is worth the most while a van mode or multiball runs, but a shot handed over this way scores flat, skipping the Ray Gun and playfield multipliers; it will spot an Overlord shot toward the lock, yet never the phase-ending Overlord shot or the arena targets beside it
control.when: a van mode or multiball is running with shots lit

lights.then: Bank charges by hitting the UFO captive ball -- a quick shot in off the upper flipper doubles the UFO bonus -- and save your presses for the biggest lit shot you cannot reach cleanly on your own.

lights.name: Area 51 Multiball
lights.lit: Five Right Ramp shots qualify Area 51 Multiball, and on Premium and LE the ramp then diverts the ball up to the Area 51 mini-playfield.
lights.then: Start it at the Right Ramp and score the divert jackpots; after eight, take the super -- a Right Ramp into the captive ball on Pro, or the hidden secret-files target up top on Premium and LE -- and it stacks on top of any Overlord multiball you have running.

lights.name: Bot Standups & Frenzy Spinner
lights.lit: The four bot standups each step the center-spinner value up toward eight times, and the Bot Award target cycles its offer -- ball save, then Mod-ulator Frenzy, then Bot Frenzy -- handing you whichever is lit when you collect.
lights.then: Hit all four bots to build the spinner, collect the third Bot Award to light Bot Frenzy at the Left Ramp, then rip the center spinner once for the whole built-up value -- it drops back down afterward, so rebuild the bots before the next rip, ideally inside a multiball under 3x playfield.

lights.name: FooBot Parts & Wizard
lights.lit: Six inserts, one per band member, light as you earn each FooBot part from a different feature -- Torso from Combotron, Head from Area 51, the arms from an Overlord super and Bot Frenzy, the legs from a one-visit city and Supersonic Radio -- and each collected part also grants a 2x at that member's shot.
lights.flashing: The Left Ramp flashes for FooBot Multiball once all six parts are assembled.
lights.then: Assemble all six and start FooBot Multiball off the Left Ramp; then save every city plus Austin and D.C., play all three Overlord multiballs, and clear FooBot to light The Final Battle, the four-phase full wizard.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Roll through the return lanes three times and one inlane lights for Super Spinner; a flipper tap swaps it to the other side, so set it under the ball, roll through, then rip the spinner while it pays five times its value.

scoring.text: Soft-plunge the Rock-O-Meter skill shot to set the playfield multiplier climbing, then neutralize the Overlord early -- backhand its captive ball from the right flipper, since it is the game's number-one drain risk. Mod your van for extra mode time at the Mod-ulator and start New Orleans, the easiest city to read.

Hold your last Rock-O-Meter shot until an Overlord multiball and a van mode are already running, THEN trigger 2x playfield and layer Area 51 on top -- the signature stack. Arm the Ray Gun pair to point a 4x at your biggest shot inside it.

Assemble all six FooBot parts for FooBot Multiball, then satisfy every requirement -- all six cities plus Austin and D.C., all three Overlord multiballs, and FooBot -- to start The Final Battle. Its four phases each run about a minute with unlimited ball save, and finishing it steps every FooBot shot multiplier up for your next game.
